name: On a First-Name Basis with the Dead
source:
What kind of person does it take to be a necromancer, those who commune with the dead? An insane one? A regretful one? Or perhaps even an envious one?

[From [url=https://nagilawfultired.itch.io/first-name]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
什么样的人才能成为死灵法师，那些与死者交流的人？一个疯子？一个遗憾的人？或者甚至是一种嫉妒？

[来自[url=https://nagilawfultired.itch.io/first-name]Itch.io[/url]]
